content:
The **Bunker Buster** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*.

The Bunker Buster is a hidden, unique modification applied to its standard counterpart. In addition to its unique name, it has the Dangerous legendary effect which grants +20% damage. It also comes already equipped with the targeting computer and triple barrel modifications. The weapon is awarded by MODUS at the end of One of Us upon joining the Enclave.

A bunker buster is a type of munition that is designed to penetrate deep underground bunkers.
